problem: Unfinished interaction migration leaves cue placement stuck, transient Colyseus messages unsent, stale pointer velocity capable of accidental shots, and CI blocked before build. Complete the existing PR without bypassing its quality or publication gates.
reuseDecision: Extend the existing deterministic match, canonical coordinates, shot interaction owner, Colyseus room adapter and browser harness. Keep one pointer sampler with injected event timestamps; no gesture dependency, copied game code, prototype interception, second physics implementation or new feature branch. Remove unreachable migration implementations. Keep an authoritative server boundary isolated from browser presentation.
nonGoals: Copy Miniclip code, branding, textures, sounds, table artwork, or proprietary assets
Replace the existing Personal Island, Parking Jam, Junkyard Station, Modoki, or Three.js foundations
Turn the billiards presentation into a second physics or scoring implementation
Provision or claim a live multiplayer hosting service without an actual endpoint
